title: WaterColor "Beachside 22" 1848 E. Co. Hwy 30A
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 10 wristbands.- Panoramic views of the Gulf- 2 large private Gulf-front balconies- Steps to separate private condo pool- Steps away from the beach walkover- Close to the beach club- Recently renovated- 3 Adult Bikes (4 Max Per HOA)- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Completely renovated townhome in WaterColor with incredible Gulf views! This 3-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom, beachfront condo features elegant and tasteful new decor throughout the perfectly spacious unit for up to 10 guests. Nearly every room in the condo features unobstructed Gulf views, so every guest can wake up to paradise! There is also a third-floor balcony with outdoor seating to enjoy the best possible view of the sunset, sunrise, moonrise, and starry nights without any distractions. The main level of the home begins on the third floor, with professionally designed kitchen, dining, and living rooms, all with panoramic Gulf and pool views. The updated kitchen features Quartzite countertops and stainless-steel appliances. The beachfront primary suite features a king bed, twin sleeper chair, and desk with access to the large beachfront balcony. The second primary located on the same level includes a king bed, twin sleeper chair, and en-suite bath with shower only. There is also a media room with a queen sleeper sofa and twin sailboat bed to accommodate extra guests, near half bath. Venture outside to enjoy the sunrise or sunset cocktails on the large balcony with panoramic views of the Gulf and community pool. The fourth floor features an exceptional guest room with a king bed, private bathroom, and large private beachfront balcony, coffee bar with mini-fridge and microwave. Located just steps from one of the many neighborhood pools, guests will love being able to walk to the pool, ocean, or the recently completed WaterColor Beach Club! 3 adult bikes are included with the home that can be used to cruise along 30A to the many amenities in Seaside or across Western Lake to Grayton Beach. With plenty of room, the unbeatable location, and amazing views, this home truly has it all. Don't miss your chance to stay in the award-winning community of WaterColor and book today.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 10):MAIN FLOOR:- Kitchen, Dining Room, Living Room, Media Room, Half Bath, Large Private Gulf Front Balcony, Private Staircase access to Pool- Primary Bedroom: King Bed and Twin Sleeper Chair, En-suite Bathroom with separate Shower and Tub, Balcony Access- Junior Primary Bedroom: King Bed and Twin Sleeper Chair, Private Bathroom with Shower - Media Room: Queen Sleeper Sofa, Twin Sailboat Bed, Half BathFOURTH FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Ensuite Bathroom with Tub/Shower, Large Private Gulf Front Balcony, Coffee Bar, Mini Fridge, and Microwave*The elevator is not for guest use.Disclaimer: All Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be arranged through The Electric Cart Company. Only one cart is allowed per home, and rentals are on a first-come, first-served basis, with a limit of 60 vehicles allowed in the community at any time. Additionally, WaterColor condominium buildings do not have exterior outlets for charging Low-Speed Vehicles/Low-Speed Vehicles (LSVs). 360 Blue does not provide extension cords for charging. Please reach out to discuss any charging needs.
